name: command-bar
description: Replace Cmd+K / Ctrl+K search with a command launcher for apps, destinations, and settings; its first page sends no requests. Enter Sessions to search them. Knowledge, artifact, skill, and prompt search returns when you disable it.
author: kirocrew
useCases: Jump to apps, settings, sessions that need attention, or a new agent request without leaving the keyboard.
configuration: It is enabled by default: press Cmd+K or Ctrl+K anywhere, type a command, and use the Sessions scope for recent or matching conversations.
